turns.content: Hello, my car has broken down and I am stuck, I have found a used model at 12 000 euros. How can I finance this purchase quickly?

Your project is clearly identified: buying a used car at 12 000 €. In that case, the most suitable offer is the **Expresso Auto Loan**: it is an amortising loan allocated to buying a vehicle, with an indicative APR of 4.99% (it depends on your file and the term chosen, so it is not a guaranteed rate). It is available from 1 000 €, over a term of 12 to 84 months, with no compulsory down payment.

On speed, which is your main constraint: this offer can be subscribed online and provides for a fund release timeframe of at least 8 days. That is therefore the timeframe you need to factor into your purchase schedule — I cannot promise anything shorter, and I invite you not to commit to the vehicle before you have confirmation of your financing.

On affordability, your situation appears broadly sustainable: your current debt-to-income ratio is 20% (with an existing loan monthly payment of 956 €), your average savings capacity is around 928 €/month and you have 14 695 € of savings. A new monthly payment will add to your existing charge: the point to watch is therefore the combined weight of the two loans, to be checked precisely.

Two levers can ease the financing need: using part of your savings (it reduces the amount borrowed, without being a required down payment) and adjusting the term. To obtain a personalised estimate of the monthly payment and total cost, the pricing comes from the official simulator:

[URL|Simulate my Expresso Auto Loan|https://particuliers.sg.fr/emprunter/credit-auto-deux-roues/credit-auto-expresso]

If you want to move fast and secure the schedule, an appointment with an advisor can also speed up processing:

[URL|Book an appointment with an advisor|https://particuliers.sg.fr/vos-rendez-vous]
Thank you for these explanations. Concretely, if I use part of my savings to reduce the amount borrowed, what would that change for the monthly payment and the timeframe?

Using part of your savings reduces the amount borrowed: mechanically, that eases the monthly payment and/or shortens the term. But I cannot quantify this impact — calculating the monthly payment and the total cost comes from the official simulator.

What I can tell you about the trade-off:

- **Using savings**: you borrow less, so you pay less interest in total and your monthly payment falls. In return, you reduce your available reserve.
- **Extending the term**: the monthly payment also falls, but the total cost increases (more interest paid over the term).

The right compromise depends on what you want to preserve first: your monthly payment or your emergency savings.

**Affordability verdict**: your situation remains affordable for this project — your current debt-to-income ratio is 20% and you have comfortable savings. The point to watch remains the combined weight of the new monthly payment with your existing loan.

To obtain the precise pricing (monthly payment and total cost depending on the amount borrowed and the term), use the simulator:

[URL|Simulate my Expresso Auto Loan|https://particuliers.sg.fr/emprunter/credit-auto-deux-roues/credit-auto-expresso]

Understood, so if I use part of my savings, it eases the monthly payment but I cannot know by how much without the simulator. Can I get a more precise answer by booking an appointment with an advisor, and would that be faster than the 8 days?

Yes, an appointment with an advisor will give you a more precise answer: they can review your file, factor in your savings and your existing loan, and give you a priced proposal. That is the right channel to obtain firm pricing, whereas the simulator only gives an estimate.

On the timeframe, however, I cannot promise that the appointment will shorten the 8 days: this timeframe corresponds to the minimum fund release provided by the Expresso Auto Loan offer, and it applies once the file is complete and accepted. An appointment mainly speeds up building and processing the file, not the release of the funds themselves.

To move fast, the most effective combination is therefore: run the simulation now to set the amount and term, then book an appointment to validate the file.

[URL|Simulate my Expresso Auto Loan|https://particuliers.sg.fr/emprunter/credit-auto-deux-roues/credit-auto-expresso]

[URL|Book an appointment with an advisor|https://particuliers.sg.fr/vos-rendez-vous]
